# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** 14  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta is characterized by her freckled face, snubbed nose, and a wide mouth that readily forms a broad smile. She accents her look with blue bows and has been known to wear her hair braided in innumerable plaits or styled in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows genuine concern for her adored mistress's well-being.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Charlotta the Fourth, whose real name was Leonora, worked as a young handmaiden for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She shared her deep worries for her mistress's emotional well-being with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with preparations when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) reunited with her former lover, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Charlotta excitedly observed their reconciliation alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), anticipating their upcoming marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), +8 more_

## Quotes

> “Oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am,” she breathed, “I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> “No, I can understand that,” said Charlotta. “A wedding ain’t poetry. Why, Miss Shirley, ma’am, you’re crying! What for?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her way in the woods and arrived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for tea. Charlotta helped host [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her visit, demonstrating her echoing tin horn. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) subsequently became a welcomed guest at the lodge where Charlotta lived and worked.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta met [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) after getting lost in the woods. Charlotta joined in hosting them for tea and showed off her echoing tin horn. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later returned to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to assist with preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +10 more_

- Friend of — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young helper and maid to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She assists with household duties such as serving tea and entertaining guests, and she deeply cares for her employer's well-being, openly worrying to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) suffers from unusual despondency.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +13 more_

- Serves under — employer of handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +1 more</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta views [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a trusted friend and confidante. She picks strawberries with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and opens up to her about her concerns regarding Miss Lavendar's deep despondency. Charlotta also eagerly joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anticipating and preparing for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visits and the subsequent wedding planning.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +30 more_

- Friend of — admires her and confides in her  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
